0.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_001
0.description: Oh? You're still here? Got something you'd like to ask?

11.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_003
11.description: Tell you what: I'll repeat the exact same thing I told you before when I first laid eyes on you and your bewildered friends. Ahem!

12.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_004
12.description: "Don't know how it is in your homeland, but here, if an animal manages to survive a hundred years, it begins to get ideas. Delusions of grandeur. Some small power, sure, but nothing much to speak of.“

13.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_005
13.description: "Survive ten times that and you become a full-fledged auspice, though. Speech! Magicks! It's quite the change, believe me, which is why we call it...<hex:021A020203>the change<hex:021A020103>. What? I never said it was something clever.“

14.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_006
14.description: "Anyway! Point is, don't let our appearances fool you. I could kill you five times before you hit the ground. But I won't, on account of me being civil. For now.“<hex:02100103>Not bad, eh? My mother always told me I was talented.

15.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_007
15.description: Hm? The temple? Now I know someone had to have told you about that before. Forgetful bugger, aren't you?

16.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_008
16.description: A long, long time ago, an auspice named Koryu succumbed to the aramitama and went mad with rage. You know, kill everyone, destroy everything. Anyway, Tenzen and the Four Lords put a stop to his murderous rampage and sealed him here.

17.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_009
17.description: Afterwards, in order to strengthen the wards binding Koryu, the Four Lords used their powers to build a magnificent temple! And that temple is...this one, of course! You don't see any other temples around here, do you?

18.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_010
18.description: Now this really ought to go without saying, but don't go messing about the inner sanctum touching the sacred crystal or breaking the sacred wards! Not unless you want to free Koryu and turn the Ruby Sea into the Ruby Sea of Fire or summat.

19.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_011
19.description: Of course, since the world is filled with treasure hunters and cavalier idiots, the Four Lords hid the temple and recruited fellow auspices like yours truly to stand guard. So while it was never intended to be a home for us, it more or less became one.

20.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_012
20.description: Ah, Tenzen. Never knew him personally, but a decent bloke by all accounts.

21.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_013
21.description: He was a samurai and traveling companion of the Four Lords. Apparently he had the ability to converse with all sorts of living creatures. Some even said he could converse with this star itself, silly as it sounds.

22.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_014
22.description: Anyway, Tenzen made no effort to hide his conversational talents, which invariably led to people calling him a demon or a witch. But despite that, he still liked to lend a helping hand where he could. Can't say I'd've done the same, but it seems to have paid off in the end.

23.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_015
23.description: At some point during his travels with the Four Lords, people start calling Tenzen a hero, and tales of his derring-do reach the ears of this king who decides to summon Tenzen and ask him to give Koryu what for. Sure enough, Tenzen says yes.

24.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_016
24.description: Now, Tenzen's strong─stronger than the Four Lords at this point, even─and we've already established his altruistic streak. So off he goes, Phoenix Blade in hand, confronts Koryu, and sacrifices himself to seal the mad auspice away. Should've seen that one coming, am I right?

25.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_017
25.description: The Ruby Sea and everyone in it are saved. People tell their children and their children's children of Tenzen's deeds, changing the details bit by bit. And that's how we end up with a ridiculous story about him and the Four Lords driving a host of oni into the sea.

26.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_018
26.description: Genbu? Hasn't he been talking your ear off this whole time? Thought you'd know by now who he is. I mean, I'll indulge you, if that's really what you want...

27.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_019
27.description: He's old and he's wise and he's got bad eyes─Genbuuu!♪<hex:02100103>Ahem. But seriously, he's one of the Four Lords. The most powerful, or at least he was at one time. He'd be the first to tell you he's not as spry as he used to be.

28.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_020
28.description: But I suppose that's to be expected given that he's been using his strength to sustain Koryu's wards for, oh, several millennia, give or take? That's sure to wear anyone down.

29.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_100_020
29.description: Shame how he went out. That Koryu's not one to be trifled with, no sir. But hey, at least Soroban was ready and willing to fill his boots. Or is it shell? Anyway, you know what I mean.

30.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_200_020
30.description: Gonna be strange having the both of them in one body for the next few centuries. It's for the best, what with Soroban needing a lot more training, but I don't know if I'll ever get used to the sight of him arguing with himself.

31.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_021
31.description: Err...you're asking about our Byakko? Great big white tiger? The one you and your fellow warriors fought in a pitched battle to save his soul? Not some other Byakko, to be clear?

32.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_022
32.description: Like Genbu, he's one of the Four Lords. From Yanxia, originally, though that was long before my time.

33.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_023
33.description: Apparently his fellow tigers didn't much care for his snow white coat and cast him out. Personally, I'm rather envious of it. Can you imagine me with those stripes? No? Never mind...

34.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_024
34.description: Where was I? Ah, right. So one day Tenzen chances to meet Byakko, who does his usual “Go away or I'll eat your face!” bit. But Tenzen's having none of it, and somehow manages to convince Byakko to stop sulking and instead join him on an adventure or two.

35.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_025
35.description: And wouldn't you know it, the ol' curmudgeon takes to life on the road like a fish to water! The two become inseparable, and together they manage to save Yanxia from a half-dozen calamities. Just goes to show you never know until you try, eh?

36.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_030
36.description: I'm starting to wonder if you've got some sort of difficulty remembering things. Maybe too many whacks to the noggin over the years?

37.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_031
37.description: Anyway, as I'm fairly certain she already told you, Suzaku was born with fiery red plumage that caught the eye of one and all.

38.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_032
38.description: Unfortunately, this meant that an awful lot of idiots mistook her for the Firebird, a legendary being that could confer immortality upon those it deemed worthy or some such rubbish. Needless to say, they chased her all over!

39.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_033
39.description: Tenzen, however, was different. He was the first man she ever met who appreciated her for who she was.

40.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_034
40.description: Bam! Just like that, she fell head over heels for the samurai. Not that I blame her. Everyone wants to be loved─even peerless warriors like you and me.

41.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_035
41.description: No one knows for sure, but Suzaku thinks that it was the unbearable pain she carried with her in the years following Tenzen's death that drove her to manifest powers reminiscent of the Firebird. So that others wouldn't have to suffer like she had...

43.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_040
43.description: I guess it's to be expected that a hero's memory would be shot full of holes due to all that head trauma. Can't be helped, as the Hingans are wont to say.

44.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_041
44.description: Seiryu had the good fortune to be born on an island where they were pretty fond of snakes, so when he got older and started to attain a measure of divinity, the people there began to worship him. 'Course, being so young, he couldn't do a damn thing to help them when life took a turn for the worse.

45.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_042
45.description: So they give child sacrifice a try, and wouldn't you know it? Their fortunes improve. Pure coincidence─especially since Seiryu set them free in secret, but after that the people started thinking their patron snake was more of a demon than a guardian. Hired hunters and the like to kill him. Bloody fools.

46.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_043
46.description: Tenzen comes along, doles out a beating, and takes pity on the snake, who joins the gang. Seiryu's fairly fond of our samurai─though he vows to grow stronger and more dragon-like that he might one day beat him in a rematch. Unfortunately, he never gets the chance. And so it goes...

47.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_100_500
47.description: Remember: don't let our appearances fool you. I could kill you five times before you hit the ground. But I won't, on account of me being civil. For now.

48.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_500
48.description: It's been more than a few centuries since I last saw Byakko. He looks good!

49.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_501
49.description: Looks like we owe you one, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I'd certainly have balked at facing Byakko in battle, what with those fangs and claws...

50.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_510
50.description: If anyone can make Suzaku see reason, it's you. Good luck!

51.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_511
51.description: Brought Suzaku back to her senses, did you? Hah, as if there was ever any doubt! Easy money, I told Kamaitachi, but the greedy bugger couldn't help but take the long odds.

52.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_520
52.description: You'll be putting a stop to this Koryu business, aye? You damn well better. If he breaks free, it's not just the temple that's done for, but the Ruby Sea and everyone in it...

53.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_525
53.description: Glad all that's over with─for now. The collective'll be staying here for the foreseeable future, in case you were wondering. Someone's gotta keep an eye on things for the next couple of thousand years, after all.

54.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_530
54.description: You're all right, friend. I'll be sure to say as much to the next hero what comes knocking a few millennia from now when we need to do this whole song and dance all over again.

55.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_550
55.description: You mean Isshu? Well, he's <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> Tenzen's descendant, that's for sure. Bit of a letdown, if you ask me.

56.name: TEXT_REGOTH3REISEN_00452_SENRI_000_551
56.description: At least he's not running around selling worthless charms anymore. Still, if it really was that profitable, then it's only a matter of time before some greedy idiot gives it another go. All the more reason for me to make more regular trips for dango, you know?
